thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: Service error spike detected
incident-bot: INC-2026-447 | EU-WEST1 | 5xx rate for /v1/generate > 12% over baseline for 5m. Paging @alex and @maya. Link: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-447
alex: Oncall here, joining bridge. Starting logs + metrics.
maya: Looking at pod logs — KV cache eviction storms on serving-12.
maya: Command: ```kubectl -n serving logs serving-12 --since=15m | grep -i evict``` 
alex: Confirming increased tail latency and dropped streams. Temporarily disabling prefix caching for eu-west1 to stop thrash.
sam: FYI I can flip a partial routing rule to route heavy tenants to dedicated pool, if needed.
alex: Do it. Sam, please route tenant:acme to dedicated-reserved-2 for now. :thumbsup:
sam: Routing rule applied, confirmed. Tail error rate dropping to ~3%.
prod-comms: Draft status page update — please review:
prod-comms: ```Status: Partial degradation in eu-west1 impacting text generation API /v1/generate. We are investigating and have mitigations in place. Customers may see increased latency or 5xx errors for a subset of traffic.``` 
liaison-jordan: Suggest adding ETA: "mitigation in progress, next update in 30 min."
prod-comms: Updated draft. Also a customer-facing email template ready — review below.
prod-comms: ```Hi {customer},
We detected elevated errors for text generation in eu-west1 earlier today. Our team has applied routing mitigations and a temporary cache configuration change. You may see reduced latency and fewer errors within 30–60 minutes. Contact support if you notice persistent issues.
— Redwood Inference Ops
``` 
nina: I'll prep targeted outreach to top affected customers (Acme, BrightCo). Want approval to send after next update.
alex: Approve send after next status update if error rate < 1.5%.
ops-scheduler: Because this surfaced a cache bug, we're scheduling a brief maintenance window to apply a config fix tomorrow 02:00–03:00 UTC. Notifying customers in next comms.
maya: Note for oncall handoff: root cause likely cache eviction + hot key causing GC on one host. Draining serving-12 and reprovisioning on warm node worked.
alex: Handoff to sam for next 12h. Summary: partial routing applied, prefix cache disabled in eu-west1, serving-12 drained. Keep monitoring keys and latency.
sam: Taking over. I'll keep an eye on dashboards and send a customer update in 25m.
incident-bot: INC-2026-447 status changed -> Mitigated by action (routing and cache toggle). Severity -> Sev2. Next update scheduled at 1755560450.
prod-comms: Final status update ready to post to status page once sam confirms stabilization.
sam: Confirming stabilization, 5xx < 0.5% for 15m. Please post status: Resolved and maintenance scheduled. :white_check_mark: 
prod-comms: Posted: ```Resolved — partial degradation in eu-west1 resolved. A follow-up maintenance window is scheduled to permanently fix the cache eviction issue.```
